D-019 human cross-check CLOSED 2026-07-23 (M2a online debt cleanup): fetched all 5 DBLP TOC pages under dblp.org/db/conf/emnlp/ (slugs discovered via the emnlp index page: emnlp2023=main, emnlp2023t=tutorial, emnlp2023d=demo, emnlp2023i=industry, emnlp2023f=findings -- a clean 1:1 match to this fixture's 5 volumes). Each DBLP TOC page counts exactly 1 more 'entry inproceedings' than this fixture's per-volume paper_count; inspecting the extra entry in main/tutorial/demo/industry confirms it is a single DBLP-catalogued 'Frontmatter.' record (aclanthology.org/2023.emnlp-main.0 etc., the volume cover page) that this fixture's XML-derived counts correctly exclude as a non-paper -- so main/tutorial/demo/industry reconcile to an EXACT MATCH once the Frontmatter entry is subtracted. findings is the one exception: DBLP counts 1061 = 1 Frontmatter + 1060 contiguously-indexed real papers (2023.findings-emnlp.1..1060), vs this fixture's findings paper_count=1059 -- a residual +1 discrepancy that survives Frontmatter exclusion and was not further diagnosed within this task's request budget (no duplicate/withdrawn DBLP entries found; cause undetermined -- possibly a DBLP/Anthology snapshot-timing difference). Net: DBLP total (5 volumes, all inproceedings) = 1048+7+53+78+1061 = 2247; minus 5 Frontmatter entries = 2242; vs this fixture's total=2241 -- the entire net +1 gap traces to the findings residual above.
